name: tdarr-control
description: Control of a Tdarr distributed transcoding server (v2 API) + comprehensive transcoding / Tdarr / media-analysis / audio knowledge base. LIVE-VERIFIED on Tdarr 2.84.01. Generic passthrough over 67 documented /api/v2 endpoints + ~30 curated tools. Skill ships 13 references (3,700+ lines): codecs encyclopedia, hardware acceleration (NVENC for RTX 3060 incl HDR preservation), 6 canonical transcode workflows with real ffmpeg commands, 107 classic community plugins organized by purpose, full 85+ flow-plugin node catalog (audio/video/file/ffmpegCommand/tools/automations — incl. webRequest, apprise for 100+ notification services, customFunction, runCli, detectNonTdarrNvenc for GPU-contention avoidance, variables + arithmetic, branching, file operations), Tdarr 2.x flows with variable templating + Worker Type routing, media-analysis reference (8 status tables, quick vs thorough health checks with custom -err_detect args, stream-property filters for video/audio/bitrate/resolution/HDR/10-bit/framerate, post-transcode validation via compareFileSizeRatio + compareFileDurationRatio, footprint IDs for forensic transcode history, 12 DB collections incl. WorkerVerdictHistoryJSONDB), audio deep dive (codecs, channels, bitrate reference, 2-pass EBU R128 loudnorm, downmix with pan coefficients incl Atmos → 7.1, language routing, commentary removal, silent/clipping detection, Atmos preservation caveats), advanced-features catalog (staging/review queue, F2F, hold-after-scan, 24-hour schedules, auto-pause, stall detector, plugin SHA pinning, resolution boundaries, queue ordering, notifications, Tdarr Pro, bumped files), library + node config (mapped vs unmapped, path translators, gpuSelect, custom thorough-health-check args), diagnostics + health (quick/thorough checks, statistics, job reports, troubleshooting playbook), integrations (auth with seededApiKey, Discord webhooks, tdarr_inform from Sonarr/Radarr, tdarr_autoscan, Plex/Emby triggers, Heimdall/Homer). All writes confirm-gated; kill-worker/disconnect-node/kill-file-scanner doubly-gated.
